<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Sinking Jaws](/Feats.aspx?ID=5430) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 67

**Archetype** [Beastmaster](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=50)

**Prerequisites**
[Beastmaster Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=1900); animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack

</column>

---

Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Sinking Jaws activity.

 **Sinking Jaws** <actions string="Single Action" /> **Requirements** This companion has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) with its jaws or fangs; **Effect** This companion's grabbed or restrained foe takes piercing damage equal to the companion's level plus Strength modifier.

prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack
